venture_data.name: CloudSync

founder_info.name: Alice Johnson
founder_info.experience: VP Engineering at Salesforce for 8 years, shipped 3 enterprise products
founder_info.background_summary: Enterprise software veteran with strong execution track record

venture_data.problem_statement: Enterprise data sync between SaaS applications is manual and error-prone. Finance teams spend 10+ hours/week on data reconciliation.

opportunity_screening.founder_assessment: Alice has 8 years enterprise software experience at Salesforce, led 3 product launches. No prior startup founding. Technically strong, execution bias. Minor risk: first-time founder.

problem_validation.customer_feedback: All 18 customers confirmed 4-10 hours/week manual data sync work

market_analysis.competitive_landscape: Zapier (general automation), native integrations exist but limited

feasibility_assessment.major_risks: Data quality validation, customer onboarding complexity
